Subject:
DISCLOSUREOFMATERIALINFORMATION
Dear Sir / Madam,
In accordance with Section 96 of the Securities Act, 2015 and Clause 5.6.1 (a) of the Rule Book
of Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited, we are pleased to inform that Tariq Glass Industries Limited
("TGL" / the “Company") has received approval from the Authority of Quaid-e-Azam Business
Park - Special Economic Zone (QABP-SEZ), Sheikhupura, for entry of the Company as a Zone
Enterprise.
In this regard, the Authority has earmarked / allocated approximately 10.41 acres of land to the
Company for the establishment of a proposed manufacturing facility relating to value-added glass
and alliedproducts.
The proposed project forms part of the Company's strategic expansion and diversification plans
aimed at enhancing its manufacturing capabilities and strengthening its presence in the value-
addedglasssegment.
The Company shall now proceed with completion of the requisite regulatory, administrative and
operational formalities for the erection, development and commissioning of the proposed plant.
The above is being disseminated to all concerned in compliance with applicable legal and
regulatory requirements.
This is for your information and dissemination amongst the TRE certificate holders. The
Disclosure Form in terms of Section 96 oftheSecuritiesAct 2015in relation to inside information
is attachedasAnnexure-A.
Yourssincerely,
For Tariq Glass Industries Limited
(Mohsin Ali)
CompanySecretary
